title: ELISA Protocol: Antibody Addition
author: Opentrons
materials: Water, diluent, and HCP standards, and diluted samples will be transferred to the output plate in duplicate. User will need to upload the same CSV file used in part 1 of the protocol. See Additional Notes in Part 1 for more details on the CSV requirements. Download full protocol details [here](https://s3.amazonaws.com/opentrons-protocol-library-website/custom-README-images/1464-natrix-separations-inc-milliporesigma/NEW_ELISA_protocol.xlsx). --- You will need: * P300 Multi-channel Pipette * P300 Single-channel Pipette * [Opentrons Tube Racks (2 mL Eppendorf)](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/tube-rack-set-1) * [Opentrons Tube Rack (15 + 50 mL)](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/tube-rack-set-1) * [2 mL 96-deep well Plate](https://www.usascientific.com/2ml-deep96-well-plateone-bulk.aspx) * 96-well Plate * 12-row Trough * 300 uL Tip Racks
Select the number of standards you are using.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather required equipment
steps.instruction: Collect a P300 multi‑channel pipette, a P300 single‑channel pipette, Opentrons 2 mL Eppendorf tube rack, Opentrons 15 + 50 mL tube rack, a 2 mL 96‑deep‑well plate, a 96‑well plate, a 12‑row trough, and 300 µL tip racks.

steps.title: Upload concentration CSV
steps.instruction: Upload the same concentration CSV file that was used in Part 1 of the ELISA protocol.

steps.title: Download and load protocol
steps.instruction: Download the full protocol Excel file from the provided link and upload it into the Opentrons OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck as shown in the deck map: place the 96‑well output plate in slot 9, load the tube racks, tip racks, and any other labware in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate all labware, tip racks, and both pipettes (P300 multi‑channel and single‑channel) following the app’s calibration procedure.

steps.title: Run ELISA antibody addition
steps.instruction: Execute the protocol: the robot will add Enzyme Conjugate Reagent to every column of the output plate in slot 9, then transfer water, diluent, HCP standards, and diluted samples to the output plate in duplicate as specified in the CSV.

substeps.instruction: Add Enzyme Conjugate Reagent to all required columns in the output plate (slot 9).
Transfer water, diluent, HCP standards, and diluted samples to the output plate in duplicate.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to begin the automated steps.
